The '''2020 Copa Libertadores group stage''' was played from 3 March to 22 October 2020.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_aprobado_consejo_13_06_2019.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref><ref name="calendar_new">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2020_version_pos_pandemia_06_07_2020_aprobado_consejo.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2020 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2020 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/docs2020/Manual-de-Clubes-Libertadores-2020-es.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw /><noinclude>
The draw for the group stage was held on 17 December 2019, 20:30 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/se-sortean-los-cruces-y-grupos-de-la-libertadores-y-sudamericana-2020|title=Se sortean los cruces y grupos de la Libertadores y Sudamericana 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=16 December 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/pautas-del-sorteo-conmebol-libertadores-2020|title=Pautas del Sorteo CONMEBOL Libertadores 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=9 December 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-hoja-de-ruta-de-la-gloria-eterna-rumbo-rio-de-janeiro-2020|title=La hoja de ruta de la Gloria Eterna rumbo Rio de Janeiro 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 December 2019}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL ranking of the Copa Libertadores'' as of 15 December 2019 (shown in parentheses),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/docs2020/RankingCONMEBOL-2020.pdf|title=Ranking CONMEBOL - Opta, 16-12-2019|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/dcc_282_2019_-_pauta_del_sorteo_cla_cs_2020_con_bolilleros.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2020 SISTEMA DE SORTEO – Fase Preliminar y Fase de Grupos & CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2020 SISTEMA DE SORTEO – Primera Fase|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 2010–2019
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores results in the period 1960–2009
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years
</noinclude>
For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the four winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2020 Copa Libertadores final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2020 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]]. The third-placed teams of each group entered the [[2020 Copa Sudamericana second stage|Copa Sudamericana second stage]].<section end=Format />

==Schedule==
The schedule of each matchday was as follows (Regulations Article 2.2.2).<ref name="regulations"/><ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/fixture-fase-preliminar-y-fase-de-grupos-conmebol-libertadores-2020|title=Fixture – Fase Preliminar y Fase de Grupos CONMEBOL Libertadores 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=18 December 2019|language=es}}</ref><ref name="fixture_pdf">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_conmebol_libertadores_22_01_2020.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=22 January 2020|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/calendario-de-partidos-de-la-fase-de-grupos|title=Calendario de partidos de la Fase de Grupos|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=28 February 2020|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_conmebol_libertadores_28_02_2020_fase_de_grupos.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=22 January 2020|language=es}}</ref>

On 12 March 2020, CONMEBOL announced that the tournament would be temporarily suspended after matchday 2 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], with matches on matchday 3, originally scheduled for 17–19 March 2020, postponed to a later date to be confirmed.<ref name="suspension">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-conmebol-libertadores-queda-suspendida-temporalmente|title=La CONMEBOL Libertadores queda suspendida temporalmente|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=12 March 2020}}</ref> On 18 March 2020, CONMEBOL announced that the tournament would be suspended until 5 May 2020.<ref name="suspension2">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-conmebol-libertadores-queda-suspendida-temporalmente-hasta-el-05-de-mayo|title=La CONMEBOL Libertadores queda suspendida temporalmente hasta el 05 de mayo|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=18 March 2020}}</ref> On 17 April 2020, CONMEBOL announced that the tournament would be suspended indefinitely, and no date had been set for its resumption.<ref name="suspension3">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-reune-miembros-del-consejo-para-analizar-situacion-e-impacto-del-covid-19-en-el-futbol|title=CONMEBOL reúne a miembros del Consejo para analizar situación e impacto del Covid-19 en el fútbol sudamericano|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 April 2020}}</ref> On 10 July 2020, CONMEBOL announced the new schedule for the remainder of the competition,<ref name="resumption">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-libertadores-y-la-sudamericana-ya-tienen-fecha|title=La Libertadores y la Sudamericana ya tienen fecha|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=10 July 2020}}</ref><ref name="calendar_new"/> with the fixtures being confirmed on 20 July 2020,<ref name="resumption2">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/fixture-actualizado-de-la-conmebol-libertadores|title=Fixture actualizado de la CONMEBOL Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=20 July 2020}}</ref><ref name="resumption_fixtures">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_conmebol_libertadores_20_07_2020_fase_de_grupos_pos_pandemia_0.pdf|title=PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=20 July 2020}}</ref> and the updated fixtures announced on 26 August 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/programa-de-partidos-actualizado-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2020|title=Programa de Partidos actualizado de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2020|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=26 August 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_conmebol_libertadores_26_08_2020_estadios_actualizados_para_publicacion-convertido.pdf|title=CALENDARIO DE
